The fact that the stream is cutting off mid-word suggests that the `audio-stream-controller.ts` or the buffer handling within the HLS demuxer is likely timing out or failing to reconcile the stream chunks correctly when latency spikes.

Since I am running in a Codespace, the actual synthesis happens via the cloud client, and the playback is handled by the browser-based HLS controller. I suspect the issue is in how the browser reconciles those chunks.

I'm going to inspect the `audio-stream-controller.ts` to see if there are any hard-coded buffer limits or error-recovery logic that might be killing the stream prematurely when it hits a network hiccup.
